privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: Untail has no accounts and no servers of its own, and uses no third-party analytics, advertising or crash-reporting tools. The developer never receives the links you process, except when you send a report email yourself (see "Reporting a problem"). Below is when the app goes online and what it sends.
privacy.p2: Rule updates: the app contacts the rules website automatically at most once a day, or when you tap "Update rules now", to download tracking-parameter rules.
privacy.p3: Short-link expansion: when a link you submit is an allow-listed short or share link (for example Facebook, Threads, bit.ly), the app contacts that service directly from your phone to find the original URL. It sends a HEAD request first and falls back to GET only if the service does not support HEAD (page content is then downloaded but never parsed or executed). The app follows one redirect at a time: it keeps going only while the redirect stays on the same site (for example a Facebook share link leading to a Facebook post); a redirect to another site is read from the reply, and that site is not contacted. If the target is another short-link service the app knows (one short link leading to another), the app contacts that service too. You can turn this off in Settings. With "Clean clipboard links automatically" on, this also happens when the app cleans a clipboard link as it opens. Expansion requests always use HTTPS. This also happens when you clean a short link with the “Clean link” Quick Settings tile.
privacy.p4: History is kept only in the app's local storage and is never sent to any server by the app. Android system backup is disabled; on iOS it may be included, like other app data, in your own iCloud or computer backups. History can be turned off and cleared at any time.
privacy.p5: The clipboard is used only when you tap Paste or Copy, when automatic copying of clean links is on, or when "Detect links on the clipboard" is on (checked when you open the app; on iOS the app only checks whether a link is present and reads it when you tap Paste). With "Clean clipboard links automatically" on, the app reads the clipboard when you open it and replaces a link that has tracking codes or hidden characters with the clean link. Nothing else from the clipboard is stored; like a link you clean by hand, an automatically cleaned link is saved to the on-device history only when "Keep history" is on. When you tap the “Clean link” Quick Settings tile, the app opens and reads the clipboard even if “Detect links on the clipboard” is off; a link with tracking codes or hidden characters is replaced with the clean link, and saved to history only if “Keep history” is on.
privacy.p6: Reporting a problem: only when you tap "Report a problem" and then tap Send in your own mail app does an email reach the developer (ttylab80387@gmail.com). It contains the original link, the clean link, the app and rules versions, and your email address; you can see and edit everything before sending. The developer uses it only to fix the cleaning rules and deletes it once that is done, within 90 days at most; to have it deleted sooner, email the same address. The app itself sends nothing.

howto.title: How to use it
howto.copy: Copy a link, then open Untail. It notices the link.
howto.share: In another app, tap Share → Untail.
howto.shareTip: Not in the list? Look under "More" in the share sheet, and pin it to the front.
howto.auto: Swap in the clean link as soon as you open the app, without tapping.
howto.iosPaste: On iPhone, set Settings > Apps > Untail > Paste from Other Apps to Allow, or iOS will ask every time you open the app.
howto.autoConfirmBody: When you open the app, Untail reads the clipboard and swaps a link that has tracking codes or hidden characters for the clean link. For a short link it automatically contacts that short-link service to find the original URL (it keeps following redirects only within the same site and does not contact other sites), which sees your IP address and that short link. You can turn this off in Settings at any time.
howto.tile: After copying a link, pull down the notification shade and tap the “Clean link” tile, then paste in the original app.
